channel.title: SRG+ Key
channel.description: Updates of SRG+ Key for Mac, downloaded outside the App Store.

item.description: - **For agents** on logins and API keys: instructions an agent reads before it uses the item (how the site signs in, where a code comes from), separate from your private Notes. - **Sign in with** on logins: Any, Cloud browser or My Chrome. An agent signs in only where you said. - Text that holds the item's password, key or code is not saved: agents read it.

- On an agent's page, Asks Me First, Allowed and Take Back now really change the agent's access, confirmed with Touch ID. Before, they changed only what this Mac showed. - Giving an agent another item keeps its current rule, so items it may use by itself stay allowed.

- An item's «Who can use it» now lists the agents that can use it, with their pictures and whether each use asks you first. - On an agent's page, pick an item to see its details (user name, password, website); double-click it to open it among your items. - What each agent was given now shows after the app starts again.

**Move and copy items between your vaults.**
- **Move to** and **Copy to** take a login, card, bank details, API key or note from My Vault to a workspace vault you can write to, or back. Every field goes with it: the password, the two-step code, the passkey and the notes. - Right-click one item or several in the list, or use the Vault row in the item's details. - A move asks first, and the item leaves its vault only once its copy is on the server. An agent given the item loses it and must be given it again in the new vault.

- Give access now lists the items of the workspace you have open, so the login you pick is the one the agent gets. - Agents show only in a workspace you own. My Vault no longer offers them. - Each SRG+ agent shows its picture from SRG+, and Access › Agents is a page of all agents with search. - Logins and API keys show their website's icon, taken from that website only. Settings › Vault › Show website icons turns it off. - On the Mac, Settings no longer covers the last row of the sidebar.
- Agents: the list now shows the studio's SRG+ agents, so you can give one of them a login or an API key with Touch ID.

- Give an agent of SRG+ access to a login or an API key: pick the agent and the items, confirm with Touch ID. The agent signs in or calls the API through SRG+ Key and never sees the password or the key. - Agents' requests to use an item now show in the app for your yes or no.

- **Updates install by themselves.** The app checks every hour and installs a new version when you quit it. Opened from the disk image or Downloads, it first offers to move itself into Applications, where updates can reach it.

**SRG+ Key for Mac, Beta.** The first version you can download outside the App Store.
- Your passwords, two-step codes, passkeys, cards, bank details, API keys and notes, locked on your Mac with your master password and Secret Key. Unlock with Touch ID. - Fill passwords and codes in Safari and other apps: turn on SRG+ Key in System Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords. - Bring your passwords over from Apple Passwords, 1Password or a CSV file. - Sign in with your SRG+ account, and add your iPhone with a setup code. - The app checks for updates every hour and installs a new version when you say so.
This is a Beta: keep your Emergency Kit safe, and keep your important passwords in your current password app too for now.
